description: Get All Lists - Retrieve all contact lists with optional filtering. Note: boolean filters (starred/archived) are unreliable. Supported filters: folder, search, sortBy, sortType, integration. Each list includes a `fields` array — the list's columns in snake_case (e.g. first_name, email, lead_score).

limit.description: Maximum number of lists to return (default: 100)

search.description: Search query to filter lists by name

skip.description: Number of lists to skip for pagination (default: 0)

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: get_all_lists

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.

title: Get All Lists
